name: Rink Clash (Football)
description: A fast-paced 7-a-side football showdown testing teamwork, speed and strategy.
duration: 15 minutes per match (7-minute halves with a break)
format: Knockout; tied matches decided by sudden death
components: Rolling substitutions; carpet rule; last man cannot use hands to save a goal; referee’s decision is final

name: Gully Cricket (Box Cricket)
description: A high-energy box cricket competition inspired by Mumbai’s famous gully cricket culture.
duration: 3 overs per innings; match duration depends on play
format: Compulsory chase; 3 overs with 3 fresh bowlers; standard dismissals apply except LBW
components: Standing bowling inside the box; bowling action below 90 degrees; compulsory non-striker; no line crossing; no bat tapping; designated fielding positions; special 2-run and 4-run scoring rules; wides and no-balls penalised

team_size: Individual (singles); confirm if doubles are included

components: Standard table tennis rules apply
concept: A playful take on Mumbai’s lively conversations, fast pace and competitive spirit.

name: Master Stroke (Chess)
description: A battle of strategy and foresight where every move counts.

components: Queen: 9 points; Rook: 5 points; Bishop: 3 points; Knight: 3 points; Pawn: 1 point; standard chess rules apply
concept: Reflects Mumbai’s strategic mindset, where every move matters in the city that never stops.

name: Mumbai Carrom Cup (Carrom)
description: A classic indoor contest testing accuracy, concentration and tactical play.
duration: 10 seconds per shot; total match duration depends on play

components: Queen must be covered by pocketing one's own coin; fouls involving the striker, opponent’s coin or uncovered queen attract penalties
